analyticRadialFit.qualification: Least-squares fit to annular red-channel means from the bound native 128 by 128 Sun texture; fitted values only, no source pixels.

distanceScaling.qualification: The opaque photospheric core is projected from the IAU nominal solar radius and the object catalog's mean heliocentric distance. The retained glow profile remains a visual presentation; the distance is not epoch-specific.

provenance.source: JPL Horizons osculating elements; PDS source orientation held at arbitrary phase.
provenance.qualification: Computed Hartley 2 Sun direction at 2026-09-03T00:00:00 TT, expressed in the ecliptic presentation frame (north up, Sun left at zero yaw) and in view space at the default camera pose. Published PDS shape model, including poorly constrained source estimates. Both views use the gray grid for source-flagged poorly constrained regions. Source constraints keeps solid gray for stereo control and blue for limb silhouettes. Grid regions lack those constraints; they are not necessarily wholly unobserved. These are evidence categories, not surface colors. The cartographic north direction follows the long axis at the 2010 encounter, not a spin pole. Hartley 2 tumbles; this display holds an arbitrary rotational phase and does not simulate that motion.
